context: Riku and Aoi chat about a baseball season.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (野球/秒/いれ/向上/ものの) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 今シーズン、野球を頑張ってるんだ。
lines.en: This season, I'm working hard at baseball.
lines.style: eager teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 走るのも、速くなったの?
lines.en: Did you get faster at running too?
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、数秒だけど、向上したよ!
lines.en: Yeah, only a few seconds, but I improved!
lines.style: proud teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: すごいね、練習に力を入れたんだね。
lines.en: Amazing, you put effort into practice.
lines.style: admiring barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 大変なものの、毎日が楽しいよ。
lines.en: It's tough, but every day is fun.
lines.style: cheerful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 野球で、技術も向上しそうだね。
lines.en: Your skills will improve through baseball too.
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: もっと力を入れて、向上したい!
lines.en: I want to put in more effort and improve!
lines.style: determined teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 一秒でも速く、応援してるよ!
lines.en: Even a second faster — I'm cheering you on!
lines.style: bubbly barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
